name: Ultimate Media Controller — FB · IG · TikTok
description: A minimal, non-intrusive overlay for Facebook, Instagram and TikTok videos: live time/duration, playback speed, a click/drag seek bar with a PotPlayer-style hover thumbnail preview, subtitles when available, and a save/collections flow that always asks which collection a reel goes into (or lets you quick-save with none), fills its icon in once saved, and asks for confirmation before ever unsaving — while also driving Facebook's own native Save/Add-to-collection in the background with wide menu-text matching. A dedicated pill icon opens a quick, filterable list of every saved reel without leaving the page, and a per-platform dashboard shows whether each save actually confirmed on Facebook. One-click backup/restore, an optional silent auto-backup file, and an optional direct Google Drive backup (once you connect your own free Google account) mean your saved videos survive removing the extension and can live outside the browser entirely.
author: Ultimate Browser Assistant
